policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Southwest Baptist's twenty-eight goals exceed what the five lowest-scoring programmes have managed between them; the shape is no longer one bar and a slope, since Maryville's afternoon against them pulled the second bar close.
Asgrimur Vidisson has made thirty-three saves for Maryville and conceded eight, a save percentage of .805.

claims.text: Lincoln are the only programme in the conference yet to lose: three wins and two draws, seven goals scored and three conceded, with Wednesday's win at Upper Iowa their first away from home since conference play opened.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Ten different players have scored for Drury this season, and none of them appears among the conference's scoring leaders.
